Avaidikadarśanasaṅgraha
epitome of the heterodox systems, by Gaṅgādhara Vājapeyin. Burnell 123b.

Avaidikamatatiraskāra
or Avaidikadhikkṛti by Acyutarāya Moḍaka. Khuperkar
. From his own mention of this work in his Prārabdhadhvāntasaṁhṛti, it appears to be known also by another name, Śāktaśāsana. See BDCRI. XVII (1957) p.. 215-220 an. above p. 75b.

Avaidikamatapraviṣṭaprāyaścittaviveka
Pt.. in Telugu script. Pithapuram, 1917. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 242. [Page429-b]

Avaivartakacakrasūtra
Bud. Q. by Haribhadra in his Abhisamayālaṅkārāloka, GOS. LXII. p. 43.
Kanjur Kyoto 906.
See above Avivartacakra, AMG. II. p. 267 (no. 3) an. AR. XX. p. 463.

Avaivartya(?)sūtra
Bud. See Aparivarttya Sūtra above.

Avaihītyasādhutvavicāra
gr. maintains against Bhaṭṭoji that both the forms ‘Avehi’ an. ‘Avaihi’ are correct. Adyar II. p. 35a. Adyar D.
